title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. for approval by the Department of Public Utilites of an interim increase in the fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings for the billing month of November, 1985. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuels and power purchased by the Company.
